desc: Write full solution code: parse input with sys.stdin.buffer, build `out_adj` and `in_adj` lists.

Implement Dijkstra from state (1, 0) over 2N states; relax edge moves (cost 1, using out_adj if p==0 else in_adj) and flip move (cost X, same vertex, parity 1-p); use lazy deletion for stale heap entries.
Output min(dist[N][0], dist[N][1]); verify mentally against samples (sample 1 → 4, sample 2 → 3, sample 3 → 4294967299).
